result.title: CoPE-CGL: Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Replay-Free Continual Graph Learning
result.comment: Extended version with appendices. 18 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables
result.summary: Continual graph learning (CGL) maintains models as graphs evolve without retraining from scratch, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods typically target either transductive or inductive settings and often store past subgraphs or require task identifiers at inference. We propose Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Continual Graph Learning (CoPE-CGL), a replay-free framework that uses a parameter-free structural prior, precomputed by multi-hop Laplacian smoothing, to anchor learning, memory, and inference. CoPE-CGL combines topology-infused bottleneck adaptation, community-level prototypes, and dynamic routing by majority vote over node-to-prototype matches. The default protocol assumes each test graph comes from one learned task; a node-level variant handles mixed-task graphs. Each task adds at most a constant amount of storage, with no past graph data retained. At equal storage and without task identifiers, CoPE-CGL matches the strongest replay baseline even when it receives true task identifiers: average performance (AP) is 95.17% and 95.72% versus 94.28% and 95.82% on Arxiv and CoraFull, respectively, with 5.9-14.0 times faster runtime and zero forgetting. Across four transductive and three inductive benchmarks and mixed streams, CoPE-CGL exceeds the second-best of up to eleven baselines by up to 1.41, 6.32, and 9.33 AP percentage points, respectively. It runs 1.3-7.9 times faster end-to-end than the most accurate competitor on each benchmark and scales to the largest benchmark graph. On graphs mixing two tasks, its node-level variant achieves the best AP among CGL methods. The design targets homophilic graphs with community structure.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CoPE-CGL，以多跳 Laplacian 平滑预计算的参数无关结构先验锚定学习与记忆，结合社区级原型和基于节点-原型匹配的多数投票路由，实现无回放、不需任务标识的持续图学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不留存原始子图、仅用原型与结构先验维护内部状态」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态应保留哪些任务相关信息、以及按证据匹配进行推理路由提供概念参照，但无视觉推理实验可供核查。
